Test fixture: JSON outputs of the REVIEW-1 benchmark build (_out/e2e/v3, the Sleepy Bear), trimmed: no BREPs, no images.
build.json keeps purchased/printed/factory_work/tests only; pcb/backplane.kicad_pcb keeps only the footprint references.
firmware/firmware-merged.bin is an empty placeholder (the stage only checks that the image exists).
print/*.stl are empty placeholders (the planner only lists them; nothing is rendered from this fixture).
